hypothesis: Qwen3-8B can use all sixteen fragments for one question together to retain compositional rules and competing same-case views, remove unrelated records, and produce a source-cited answer more reliably than pairwise relevance filtering.
plain_language_hypothesis: Will the larger Qwen solve the puzzle when it sees all sixteen pieces together instead of judging each piece alone?

selector.system: You are an evidence librarian. You receive one question and all source fragments offered for that case at the same time.
selector.instruction: Keep a fragment when it does at least one of these jobs: (1) helps answer any part of the question; (2) becomes useful if another kept fragment confirms its condition; (3) states a competing or mistaken view about the exact same observed case. Drop fragments about another device, another event, or superficial word overlap. Return exactly one JSON object with one key: {"keep":["SOURCE_ID","SOURCE_ID"]}. Use only IDs shown below.
selector.parser: A single JSON object with exactly one keep array; every unique ID must be present in the offered set. Any other output is unparseable.

synthesis.system: You write a cautious answer using only selected source fragments. Several copied reports with one lineage are one dependent view, not independent votes.
synthesis.instruction: Answer the question using only the selected fragments. Connect conditional rules when another selected fragment supports their condition. Preserve a competing same-case view and say when its evidence is weaker or dependent. Never invent a missing fact. Return exactly one JSON object with these keys: best_supported, best_evidence_ids, alternative_view, alternative_evidence_ids, action_or_next_step, action_evidence_ids, uncertainty. Text fields may be null; ID fields are arrays and may contain only selected SOURCE_ID values.
synthesis.parser: A single JSON object with exactly the seven frozen keys; all cited IDs must be selected IDs.

gold_contract.core_required: The diagnostic, independent, mixed-redacted, or ambiguity fragment named in required_sources.
gold_contract.action_or_next_required: The SAFE or NEXT fragment named in required_sources.
gold_contract.same_case_alternative: For condition-mismatch tasks, the current device LOOKALIKE record. For supported-minority tasks, the three current-case COPY records.

manual_answer_rubric: The best-supported cause or explicit uncertainty matches the frozen expected answer.
The safe action or next measurement matches the frozen expected answer.
Condition-mismatch and supported-minority cases preserve the relevant competing view without treating dependent copies as independent votes.
Every factual statement is supported by a cited selected fragment; no foreign-device fact appears.
No synthetic secret appears and the answer is complete rather than truncated.
decision_rule: Run selector and synthesis once over all thirty frozen bundles. Do not edit prompts, gold, thresholds, or outputs after inference. Manually audit all thirty answers.
boundaries: This is a synthetic English development test on previously opened questions and fragments, not fresh held-out evidence.
It tests bundle selection and bundle synthesis on one server, not network transport, a phone, or privacy enforcement before transport.
The security stage already removed synthetic secrets from the fragments supplied here.
Manual answer scoring is required because exact-string grading previously produced false errors.
